verdicts.reason: A and B look identical: the quote and attribution are moved neatly to the left with the big quote mark, and the can-in-circle sits on the right. Both have the same flaws. The logo strip floats on its own in the middle gap, cut off from the brand content and competing for attention between the quote and the product. The SOLSTICE label on the shrunken can can't be read. The circle is squeezed against the top and bottom edges, so the right side feels cramped next to the roomy quote block.
